hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, for example astrocytes, APOE4 causes impaired ARF6-related recycling of receptors between the cell surface and the endosome, compared with APOE3.

paper.title: ApoE4 disrupts intracellular trafficking and iron homeostasis in a reproducible iPSC-based model of human brain endothelial cells.

findings.finding_description: Pulse-chase assay with fluorescent transferrin (Tf) in isogenic ApoE3 vs ApoE4 iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs, two isogenic pairs). More Tf was present after the 20-min pulse in ApoE4 cells, but the Tf recycling rate did not differ between genotypes. This argues against impaired receptor recycling in this cell type. TfR recycling stands in for receptor recycling; ARF6 itself was not studied.
findings.quote: Similarly, the total amount of Tf after a 20-min pulse was higher in ApoE4 compared to ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figure 6B), but the recycling rate was similar between the two genetic variants (Figure 6D).
findings.summary: ApoE4 did not change the transferrin/TfR1 recycling rate versus ApoE3 in human iPSC brain endothelial cells (null result against the hypothesis).
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic pairs

findings.finding_description: Live-cell imaging of fluorescent Tf in isogenic pair 1. ApoE4 iCE-BECs formed far fewer endosomal sorting tubules (the carriers involved in sorting/recycling) per area per minute than ApoE3 cells. This is a surrogate for recycling-pathway sorting; ARF6 was not assessed.
findings.quote: In contrast, the number of sorting tubules was substantially reduced in ApoE4 iCE-BECs (Figure 5H).
findings.summary: ApoE4 reduced endosomal sorting-tubule biogenesis in human iPSC brain endothelial cells.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), isogenic pair 1

findings.finding_description: Continuous-uptake assay of fluorescent Tf in both isogenic pairs. After normalization, the kinetic rate of Tf internalization did not differ between ApoE4 and ApoE3 iCE-BECs.
findings.quote: However, the rate of Tf internalization was similar between ApoE4 and ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figure 6C).
findings.summary: ApoE4 did not change the transferrin internalization rate in human iPSC brain endothelial cells.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic pairs

findings.finding_description: Continuous Tf uptake: ApoE4 iCE-BECs internalized 50% more total Tf than ApoE3 cells. The authors attribute this to TfR1 upregulation rather than altered trafficking kinetics.
findings.quote: ApoE4 iCE-BECs had a 50% higher total amount of internalized Tf compared to ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figure 6A).
findings.summary: ApoE4 increased total transferrin uptake by 50% in human iPSC brain endothelial cells.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic pairs

findings.finding_description: Flow cytometry confirmed higher total internalized Tf in ApoE4 vs ApoE3 iCE-BECs. The data are in a supplementary figure that was not available.
findings.quote: This increase in total internalized Tf was confirmed by flow cytometry (Figure S5C).
findings.summary: Flow cytometry confirmed increased transferrin uptake in ApoE4 brain endothelial cells.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs)

findings.finding_description: TfR1, the cargo receptor that recycles, was upregulated in ApoE4 iCE-BECs by immunofluorescence intensity (main effect of genotype, p<0.001) and by qPCR mRNA (p<0.001).
findings.quote: Indeed, we found that both mRNA and protein TfR1 expression were upregulated in ApoE4 compared to ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figures 6E–6I).
findings.summary: ApoE4 increased TfR1 expression (imaging and mRNA) in human iPSC brain endothelial cells.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic pairs

findings.finding_description: Western blot of TfR1 showed no significant effect of ApoE genotype on TfR1 protein (two-way ANOVA). This is a null result.
findings.quote: Note that western blots did not reflect increased TfR expression in ApoE4 cells.
findings.summary: Immunoblot showed no ApoE4 effect on total TfR1 protein.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic pairs

findings.finding_description: EEA1 immunostaining showed more early endosomes (p<0.01) and more EEA1 per endosome (p<0.001) in ApoE4 than in ApoE3 iCE-BECs. This indicates altered early endosome organization, the compartment from which receptors are recycled.
findings.quote: We found that the number of early endosomes (labeled by EEA1) was higher in ApoE4 compared to ApoE3 iCE-BECs (Figures 5A and 5C).
findings.summary: ApoE4 increased early endosome number and EEA1 content in human iPSC brain endothelial cells.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic pairs

findings.finding_description: Tf-pHrodo/Tf-647 ratio imaging showed a lower ratio per endosome in ApoE4 cells, indicating less acidic endosomes (p<0.01). This bears on endosome maturation rather than directly on recycling.
findings.quote: We found that ApoE4 iCE-BECs had increased signal for each of the Tf-fluorescent conjugates but a lower fluorescence ratio (Figures 5E and 5F).
findings.summary: ApoE4 endosomes were less acidic in human iPSC brain endothelial cells.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), two isogenic pairs

findings.finding_description: Transmission electron microscopy in isogenic pair 1 showed increased endosome number and size in ApoE4 vs ApoE3 iCE-BECs. No statistics were reported in the text.
findings.quote: We confirmed by transmission electron microscopy that ApoE4 iCE-BECs had an increase in endosome number and size compared to ApoE3 cells (Figure 5D).
findings.summary: TEM showed more and larger endosomes in ApoE4 brain endothelial cells.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic ApoE3/ApoE4 human iPSC-derived brain endothelial cells (iCE-BECs), isogenic pair 1
